page.title: Starlite 2027: Pre-Concert Yacht Cruise from Marbella Marina

data.meta_description: Book a Starlite 2027 pre-concert yacht cruise from Marbella Marina. Sail at 7pm, sip cava, watch sunset over La Concha. From €749/2h. Secure your boat now.
data.summary: Combine a Starlite 2027 concert night with a sunset yacht cruise from Marbella Marina. Depart Puerto Banús at 7pm, enjoy drinks and snacks, then head to the auditorium for the show.

faq.q: What time does the pre-concert cruise leave?
faq.a: Most pre-concert cruises depart Puerto Banús at 7pm, giving you two hours to enjoy the sunset, drinks, and coastal views before returning to dock at 9pm. Starlite doors typically open at 9:30pm, so you have plenty of time to get to the auditorium (a 10-minute taxi ride from the marina).

faq.q: Can I combine a yacht charter with Starlite tickets?
faq.a: Yes, but you need to book your Starlite 2027 tickets separately through the official Starlite Festival website. We only provide the yacht charter. Many guests book a 2-hour cruise (€749 for Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39) then head to the concert. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours is popular.

faq.q: What is included in the pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and a selection of drinks (cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, water) plus light snacks. The price also includes Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden extras — just show up at Puerto Banús at 7pm.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For couples or small groups, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax, €749/2h) or Azimut 39 (11 pax, same price) are ideal. For a party of 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski. The Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) and Pershing 46 (10 pax) are also excellent options. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What route does the pre-concert cruise take?
faq.a: Typically you’ll cruise east along the Marbella coastline, passing the Golden Mile, Río Verde, and Cala del Faro. You’ll get stunning views of La Concha mountain as the sun sets. The captain can adjust the route based on your preferences, but most guests enjoy the 2-hour sunset loop.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Starlite auditorium?
faq.a: The Starlite Festival is held at the Marbella Auditorium in Nagüeles, about 4 km north of Puerto Banús. By taxi it takes roughly 10 minutes and costs around €10–15. We recommend leaving the boat promptly at 9pm to arrive comfortably for the 9:30pm doors.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks?
faq.a: Our charters already include drinks and snacks, but you are welcome to bring additional food or a bottle of wine. Glass bottles are fine on most boats, but avoid heavy glassware. The skipper will provide glasses and ice. Let us know in advance if you have special dietary requests.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day of the cruise?
faq.a: We monitor the forecast closely. If conditions are unsafe (high winds or storms), we will offer you a full refund or reschedule to another date. In mild conditions (light chop), the cruise goes ahead — our boats are comfortable and stable. We’ll keep you informed 24 hours before departure.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2027 is set to be the Costa del Sol’s biggest summer music festival, drawing international stars to the Marbella Auditorium from June to August. For concert-goers who want to elevate their evening, a pre-concert yacht cruise from Marbella Marina is the ultimate way to start. Depart Puerto Banús at 7pm, sip cava as the sun drops behind La Concha, and arrive back at 9pm — just in time for the 9:30pm doors. With boats from €749 for two hours, it’s a seamless, luxurious addition to your Starlite night.

Why Book a Pre-Concert Yacht Cruise for Starlite 2027?

A Starlite concert is already a premium experience — but arriving directly from a sunset sail makes it unforgettable. Instead of rushing through traffic or queuing at a crowded bar, you spend the golden hour on the water with your group, enjoying the Mediterranean breeze and a glass of cava. The cruise runs from 7pm to 9pm, perfectly timed to reach the auditorium by 9:30pm. It’s a stress-free, photogenic prelude to the main event.

Our Fleet for Starlite Pre-Concert Cruises

We operate 15+ boats from Puerto Banús, all available for 2-hour sunset charters. Here are the top picks for a Starlite evening:

For larger groups (up to 12), the Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski. Smaller groups of 5 can take the Dubhe or Mariah SX21. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and IVA. Browse all our Marbella yacht charters for the full fleet.

What’s Included in Your Pre-Concert Cruise?

Every charter comes with a licensed skipper who knows the local waters, fuel for the full trip, and a welcome selection of drinks: cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. Light snacks are provided, and insurance and safety equipment are covered. Spanish IVA (21%) is included in the price. You just need to bring your Starlite tickets and a sense of occasion.

Typical Route: Sunset Along the Golden Mile

Most pre-concert cruises head east from Puerto Banús, passing the Golden Mile’s luxury villas, Río Verde, and the rocky coves of Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. As you cruise, La Concha mountain turns pink in the sunset light. The captain can adjust the route if you prefer a quieter anchorage, but the 2-hour loop is designed to maximise sunset views and return you to port by 9pm.

How to Combine Your Cruise with Starlite 2027 Tickets

Starlite 2027 tickets are sold separately via the festival’s official website. We recommend booking your yacht charter first, especially for popular concert dates (weekends and headliner nights). Once your boat is confirmed, buy your concert tickets and plan your evening: arrive at Puerto Banús at 6:45pm, board at 7pm, sail until 9pm, then take a 10-minute taxi to the auditorium. The total cost for a couple on an Astondoa 40 works out at roughly €374.50 per person (plus concert tickets).

Why Start from Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús is the most convenient departure point for Starlite. It’s a 10-minute drive from the auditorium, with plenty of parking and taxi ranks. The marina itself is a destination — lined with designer shops, restaurants, and superyachts. Arriving early lets you grab a coffee or explore before boarding. All our boats depart from the main dock in Puerto Banús, making it easy to find.

Book Your Starlite 2027 Pre-Concert Cruise

Ready to make your Starlite night even more special? Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your chosen date. We’ll help you pick the right boat, confirm the price, and send you a booking link. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is fixed at €749 for 2 hours. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94, we’ll provide a custom quote. View all our Marbella yacht charters and start planning your pre-concert cruise today.
